what_this_is: Checks that every sampled frame of a clip (one every 2 s) shows every required phrase, read by tesseract after case and whitespace are folded. Pass only when every frame has every phrase; lists the frames that miss one. No model judges the picture.

payload.label: Check that each phrase is on screen in every sampled frame (runs on your computer)
payload.job: Give a check the text it needs to find in every frame of a clip, frame by frame
payload.description: Checks that every sampled frame of a clip (one every 2 s) shows every required phrase, read by tesseract after case and whitespace are folded. Pass only when every frame has every phrase; lists the frames that miss one. No model judges the picture.

phrases.description: A JSON list of the phrases every frame must show.

invoke.say: This runs on the person's own computer.

provenance.source: ffmpeg frame extraction and the tesseract OCR engine
